title: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush
summary: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush is a 2026 racing game from the developers behind Hot Wheels Unleashed & Hot Wheels Unleashed 2: Turbocharged. Developed and published by Milestone S.r.l., the game has been released on 10 September 2026, for the Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2 and Microsoft Windows.

title: Team Hot Wheels Top Rides Series (2012)
summary: The Team Hot Wheels Top Rides Series was released exclusively at Target stores in 2012. All castings in this series are all 2011 and 2012 mainline releases on a specially designed card by the picks of the four driver teams. Each vehicle comes with a sticker sheet consisting of the Team Hot Wheels logo and the team color icon.

title: Key Force
summary: right|200pxKey Force was a short-lived series of transforming vehicle toys produced from 1992 to 1994. Each vehicle featured two different modes, which could be unlocked using a key provided with each vehicle. Once the vehicles were transformed, the keys could be inserted into slots in the car's bodies to fire missiles or activate various parts.

title: Yechin Zhao
summary: Yechin Zhao is an American designer who has worked with Mattel since 2022. Currently working with the Hot Wheels Track and Playsets team among other teams, he worked on Cars products prior to moving to the Hot Wheels brand. He can be found on social media under the handle @each.n.everyone.
